name: Belebele
intro: Belebele 是一个覆盖 115 种语言、122 个语言变体的平行阅读理解基准。它从 FLORES-200 的 488 个段落出发，经五轮英文四选一题目编写与人工、自动捷径检查形成 900 题，再由人工专家翻译和独立校对；五种印度-雅利安语言另有 IndicXlit 辅助的拉丁转写版本。
build_method: FLORES-200段落、五轮英文MCQ编写、人工与自动捷径检查、专家人工翻译和独立校对、五语言条件转写
eval_feature: 平行多语言题目、仅测试集、25%随机基线、条件式拉丁转写
scale: 900道平行题，488个段落，122个语言变体（115种语言、29种文字、27个语系），109,800行
build_method_en: FLORES-200 passages, five-round English MCQ authoring, human and automatic shortcut QA, expert human translation and independent proofreading, conditional five-language transliteration
eval_feature_en: Parallel multilingual items, test-only release, 25% random baseline, conditional Latin-script transliteration
intro_en: Belebele is a parallel reading-comprehension benchmark spanning 115 languages and 122 language variants. It starts from 488 FLORES-200 passages, creates 900 English four-choice questions through five authoring rounds with human and automatic shortcut checks, then uses expert human translation and independent proofreading; five Indo-Aryan languages additionally receive IndicXlit-assisted Latin-script variants.
scale_en: 900 parallel questions, 488 passages, 122 variants (115 languages, 29 scripts, 27 families), 109,800 rows

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2308.16884v2 Section 2.4, Sections 3.1-3.5, Figure 2, and Appendices A.5-A.6. Authoring guidelines constrain all five English-provider rounds before human sampling feedback and automatic lexical/length shortcut checks; the final iteration filters about 20%. The retained 900 questions cover 488 FLORES-200 passages. Questions and answers are translated by human experts, never machine translation, and independently proofread. Only Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Nepali, and Sinhala take the conditional IndicXlit-assisted transliteration branch before rejoining the release. The final test-only resource has 122 variants covering 115 languages, 29 scripts, 27 families, and 109,800 rows, scored by accuracy against a 25% random baseline.
